name: Contrastive Diffusion for Volume Super-Resolution (CD-TVD)
definition: The first diffusion-based approach to scientific volume super-resolution, combining contrastive pre-training on historical simulation data with fine-tuning from as few as one high-resolution timestep.
summary: CD-TVD is the first diffusion-based scientific volume super-resolution method, distinguished by contrastive pre-training and few-shot adaptation from a single exemplar.
